browse.name: Card browser
browse.description: Search with the query language, saved queries, bulk changes, trash and database check.

palette.name: Command palette
palette.description: Run any command from the keyboard (Ctrl+K) and edit shortcuts.

browse.help: Words search the text; key:value filters. -x negates, OR combines, quotes group.

bulk.heading: Change selection
bulk.notetype_help: Fields and cards are matched by key, then by position; cards of unmatched templates go to the trash. One undo step.
bulk.notetype_done: {notes, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}} moved: {kept, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} kept, {trashed} trashed, {created} new.

browse.heading: Search
browse.empty_collection_hint: Cards you create or import show up here.
browse.empty_hint: Try fewer filters or other words.
browse.deleted: Deleted {count, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}}.
browse.delete_title: Delete {count, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}}?

syntax.heading: Search syntax
syntax.deck_d: Cards in a deck (and its sub-decks)
syntax.is_d: Due today; also is:new, is:aside (set aside), is:tomorrow (left for tomorrow), is:flagged
syntax.level_d: A classification at or above a value
syntax.word_d: Every form of the word (went → go) and expressions; also status:learning / known / new / ignored, lang:en
syntax.seen_d: Words you met in at least two scenes (notes)
syntax.from_d: Where the card came from: subtitle, reading, anki, import, manual; source:"*S1E2" episode or video title
syntax.media_d: Has a sound clip taken from the video; also audio:yes / none / original / clip / tts / file, image:yes
syntax.status_d: The word's status: new, learning, known, ignored
syntax.lang_d: The word's language; lang:none = language unknown
syntax.source_d: Source title (episode, video, reading text); * matches anything
syntax.image_d: Without a picture; also image:yes / video / original / clip / file
syntax.freq_d: One of the 2000 most frequent words (needs a word-data pack)
syntax.cefr_d: CEFR level B1 or above (A1…C2; needs a word-data pack)

chips.label: Quick filters
chips.hint: The filter you pick is written into the search box, so you learn the search language too.

maintenance.heading: Maintenance
maintenance.repaired: Repaired: {trashed, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} to trash, {rescheduled} rescheduled, {reindexed, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}} re-indexed, {fixed, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}} given missing fields, {removed, plural, one {# stray value} other {# stray values}} removed.

problem.unscheduled_cards: Scheduled cards without a due date: {count}

maintenance.purge_hint: Items are deleted for good after {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} in the trash (Settings).
maintenance.purged: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} deleted for good.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.invalid_json: Parameters must be a JSON object.

shortcuts.heading: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: Click a shortcut, then press the new key combination. Esc cancels.
shortcuts.study_intro: The flip key turns the card front ⇄ back as often as you like and never rates. The rating keys work once the back has been seen. Holding a key down counts as one press.

fixed.title: Fixed keys while studying
fixed.description: These can’t be changed; each does one thing.
fixed.enter: Presses the focused button or the card (nothing else)
fixed.choice: On a multiple-choice question, picks that option
fixed.flag: Turns the card’s flag on / off
fixed.repeat: On the session summary, studies the mistakes again
fixed.inline: Adds a new card to this deck while studying

validation.saved_query_name: Give the query a name (up to 100 characters).
validation.find_replace: The search pattern is not valid.

conflict.shortcut: That shortcut is already in use.

query.too_deep: The query is nested too deeply (at most 50 levels of brackets or minus signs).
query.unmatched_paren: Closing parenthesis without an opening one.
query.expected_term: A search term is missing here.

trash_retention_days.label: Keep trash for (days)
trash_retention_days.description: Deleted decks and notes can be restored for this many days, then they are deleted for good.
